scope: Inspection of the ui-conversation source move, related candidate-tree moves, and path-gate readers

findings.subject: ContextMeter references
findings.evidence: No active source or test import uses the old skeleton/ContextMeter path; the old ContextMeter files are tracked as deleted and the input replacements are untracked. The current audit and rescope commands both fail while opening packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/ContextMeter.tsx.
findings.safe_action: Represent the complete source move in one candidate tree. Do not ignore tracked deletions, change vendor-rescope semantics, or stage the user's files as part of this diagnostic action.

findings.subject: Related UI source moves
findings.evidence: The worktree has 16 tracked source/style paths absent from disk and 16 replacement paths under ui-conversation/input, ui-sidebar-browser/browser, and ui-sidebar-documentpreview's flattened document/text layout. A temporary index containing all 16 replacements has no missing tracked paths and lets vendor rescope complete successfully.
findings.owner: The release-qualification candidate tree and client-domain implementation owner
findings.safe_action: Carry all three complete moves together when the candidate is represented; fixing only ContextMeter would leave the next deleted path exposed by vendor rescope.

findings.subject: Canonical audit baseline reader
findings.evidence: scripts/audit-metrics.ts resolves changed files with git diff --name-only. Git rename detection reports only the new name, so a baseline path removed by a rename falls through to readFileSync in the current worktree. With a temporary index containing all 16 moves and diff.renames=false, the audit passes the path read and reaches its ratchet result.
findings.safe_action: Add --no-renames to the private baseline changed-file query only. Preserve the canonical baseline corpus, metric definitions, and ratchet policy; do not make the reader hide a missing source or alter vendor-rescope.

findings.subject: Next revealed audit result
findings.evidence: The temporary all-moves candidate reaches the audit ratchet and reports packages/extensions / @deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner explicit_any at 59 against budget 58. This is the next bounded debt finding after the path-reader failure, not evidence to waive the ratchet.
findings.owner: The owner of packages/extensions/cordis-client-runner and the static-debt qualification lane
findings.safe_action: Handle the one-line ratchet increase in a successor action after the rename-safe reader repair; do not bundle an unrelated debt reduction into the reader fix.

commands.observed: No active source consumer remains; matches are limited to evidence records plus the replacement import under src/client/input.

commands.observed: 16 deleted tracked paths and 16 untracked replacements were identified across the three UI packages.

commands.command: pnpm run audit:metrics; pnpm run rescope-vendor:check
commands.observed: Both current-worktree commands fail first on the absent tracked ContextMeter path.

commands.command: Temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE with all 16 moves; pnpm run rescope-vendor:check
commands.observed: Vendor rescope verifies 7,356 tracked candidate paths with no residue and no missing-path error. The repository index was not changed.

commands.command: Temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE with all 16 moves and diff.renames=false; pnpm run audit:metrics
commands.observed: The path reader completes and reports only the independent @deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner explicit_any increase, 59 versus budget 58.

next_action: Create a successor implementation gate for the bounded --no-renames audit reader repair, then validate it against the temporary complete candidate tree.
limitations: The actual worktree remains dirty; the 16-path move is not represented by one immutable candidate and no staging, commit, publication, push, merge, release, or final verdict was performed.
The temporary index is diagnostic only and does not qualify the current candidate.
The one explicit_any ratchet increase remains unresolved and is intentionally outside the reader repair.
